name: Notre-Dame de Paris: doors
_about: Notre-Dame's doors: the three west portals under their lintels (the central one's leaves shut, its wicket the way in; the side portals' two leaves either side of the trumeau, oak under Biscornet's ironwork), the transept portals, the stair turrets' and the fleche's small doors. Coordinates in the assembly's frame (its base 0.9m up).

doors._about: the Portal of the Last Judgment
